overall_summary: Analysis of historical performance indicates that husband-wife and relationship dynamic topics significantly outperform family or purely abstract sad shayari. Content focusing on marital understanding and daily relationship realities achieved the highest views (1.6K - 1.7K views), whereas abstract heartbreak poetry struggled (under 30 views).

winning_patterns.evidence: Videos like 'पत्नी की ये बात हर पति को समझनी चाहिए' (1,674 views) and 'Shaadi Ke Baad Pyaar Kahan Chala Gaya?' (1,767 views) generated massive outlier engagement compared to channel average.
winning_patterns.action: Double down on mature relationship dilemmas, unspoken compromises, and husband-wife emotional dynamics.

weak_patterns.pattern: Abstract Sad Shayari & Heavy Philosophical Lines
weak_patterns.evidence: 'जिस दिन सच लिखूंगा… रिश्तों को षड्यंत्र लिखूंगा' received only 17 views.
weak_patterns.action: Avoid abstract, overly dramatic poetry lines without grounded, everyday visual contexts.
